column1: Xavier Edwards leads the slate with a strong hit probability and a favorable home matchup, benefiting from the platoon edge against Braxton Ashcraft and a hitter-friendly park. Edwards has recorded a hit in nearly three-quarters of his games, making him a reliable anchor for Beat The Streak lineups. CJ Abrams also offers steady production atop the Nationals’ order, with consistent recent results and a similar park boost. Pete Crow-Armstrong and Elly De La Cruz round out the top options, each with a platoon advantage but slightly less consistent hitting profiles.
